verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail's own marketing says it offers APIs to connect the virtual mailbox to other tools, which implies it can be driven programmatically without the web UI. That is the only evidence, and it is a single thin mention. missing for 10: API reference or authentication docs (e.g. API keys or service tokens suited to non-interactive use), any documented CLI or SDK, CI/headless usage guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automated operation.
